items.title: Team update
items.summary: The OpenAI team is now 45 people. Together, we’re pushing the frontier of AI capabilities—whether by validating novel ideas, creating new software systems, or deploying machine learning on robots.
items.summaryZh: OpenAI 团队规模更新至45人，旨在推动人工智能前沿能力，包括机器人部署等领域。该内容属于历史性团队公告，缺乏技术细节。
